newsitem.title: USA: Regency Realty restates Q3 FFO results.
newsitem.headline: Regency Realty restates Q3 FFO results.

text.p: Regency Realty Corp on Wednesday restated its funds from operations for the periods ended September 30, 1996 and 1995.
The company reported third quarter funds from operations of $5.48 million, or $0.51 per share, versus $3.09 million, or $0.47 per share in the same period in the prior year.

For the nine months ended September 30, 1996, the company reported funds from operations of $15.09 million, or $1.49 per share, versus $8.99 million, or $1.38 per share, in the same period in the prior year.

When the company reported its earnings on Tuesday, it showed funds from operations of $5.38 million, or $0.51 per share, for the quarter, versus $3.25 million, or $0.49, for the same period in the prior year.
For the first nine months, the company on Tuesday reported funds from operations of $15.09 million, or $1.49 per share, versus $9.47 million, or $1.45 per share, during the first nine months of 1995.
The company did not immediately return several telephone calls to explain the reason for the restatement.
